en.bdb: Cherish in heart the benevolent Creator

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਦਰੁ ਮਨਹੁਂ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaadhar manahu(n) visaariaa kudharat a(n)dhar kaadhar dhisai|

en.bdb: In nature that creator is beheld but the jiv has forgotten him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਸਾਸ ਮਾਸ ਦੇ ਜਿਸੈ ਕਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: jeeau pi(n)dd dhe saajiaa saas maas dhe jisai kisai|

en.bdb: Bestowing body, vital air, flesh and breath upon every one, He has created one and all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀਂ ਮੁਹੁਂ ਨਕੁ ਕੰਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਹਥੁ ਪੈਰੁ ਸਭਿ ਦਾਤ ਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: akhee(n) muhu(n) nak ka(n)n dhei hath pair sabh dhaat su tisai|

en.bdb: As gifts, eyes, mouth, nose, ears, hands, and feet have been given by Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀਂ ਦੇਖੈ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕੰਨ ਸਰਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: akhee(n) dhekhai roop ra(n)g sabadh surat muh ka(n)n sarisai|

en.bdb: Man beholds form and colour through eyes and through mouth and ears he speaks and listens to the Word respectively.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਕ ਵਾਸ ਹਥੀਂ ਕਿਰਤ ਪੈਰੀ ਚਲਣ ਪਲ ਪਲ ਖਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: nak vaas hathee(n) kirat pairee chalan pal pal khisai|

en.bdb: Smelling through nose and working with hands, he slides on his feet slowly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਲ ਦੰਦ ਮੂੰਹ ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਲਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: vaal dha(n)dh moo(n)h rom rom saas giraas samaal salisai|

en.bdb: He carefully keeps his hair, teeth, nails, trichomes, breath and food. Jiv, you getting controlled by the taste and greed always remember the worldly masters.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਦੀ ਲਬੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਤਿਸ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮਲ ਸੌਵੈਂ ਹਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: saadhee labai saahibo tis too(n) sa(n)mal sauavai(n) hisai|

en.bdb: Do remember that Lord too just one hundredth part of it.
Put salt of devotion in the flour of life and make it tasteful.
